contextual_resolubility_validation.validation_summary: Two referential ambiguities detected in the requirement text.

unsupported_interpretations: The access card entered by the customer is invalid.
evidence_from_requirement: The customer inserts the access card into the card reader
missing_information: Which entity the pronoun 'it' refers to when discussing the invalid PIN.
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement contains two possible antecedents for the customer and provides no disambiguating evidence.

ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: the system shall deny the access
unsupported_interpretations: The card reader denies the access.
evidence_from_requirement: If it is invalid, the system shall deny the access
missing_information: Which access (card reader or door) the system denies when an invalid PIN is entered.
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement contains two possible antecedents for the system and provides no disambiguating evidence.

overall_resolubility.explanation: At least one ambiguity is unresolved; the case must bypass Agent 3.
